facts.fact: Ares 今晨抹掉 Luca 在此工作的一切痕迹，循环监控画面以备后患
facts.anchor: I went over the logs this morning and erased all traces of Luca working here

facts.fact: Ares 放弃点开 Kayla 背景档案：此刻读档等于作弊，他把它说成战术
facts.anchor: Reading her file now would be cheating. I tell myself that this is a tactic

facts.fact: Brawley 曾警告 Ares 系统的死穴：走进一个不匹配的人
facts.anchor: one day someone is going to walk in who doesn’t fit and you won’t know what to do

facts.fact: Kayla 走进来看懂他的系统，还调整自己的行为去适配——这让他彻底卡住
facts.anchor: But she walked in, saw my system, and understood it

facts.fact: 办公室独坐时 Ares 惊觉「我在乎是否失去她」，此前从未有过
facts.anchor: It’s the moment I realize I care if I lose her

facts.fact: Kayla 笑他安慰的话像照说明书念，他答「我在即兴当好男朋友」
facts.anchor: The way you said it was like you were reading it from an instruction manual

facts.fact: Rogue 告知：昨天两名便衣警察来打听 Kayla 与 Aaron，她只说她请病假
facts.anchor: Two men came in yesterday, cops in plain clothes, and they were asking about you

facts.fact: Ares 教 Kayla 对警方口径：没见过、没联系、不知道他在哪，必要时请律师
